北山之巅，两道红色的人影相携而立。

时笙看着立着墓碑的坟墓，坟墓旁边散落着一套衣裳，正是玉箫的。

将玉箫的衣裳埋在旁边，立上石碑后，时笙才规规矩矩的鞠躬，察觉凤辞没反应，她瞪了凤辞一眼。

凤辞无辜的看着她。

好端端的小殊瞪他做什么？他今天不好看吗？

时笙黑线，拽着他强行鞠躬。

时笙沉默的站了一会儿，然后和凤辞下了山。

她无法理解那些深沉的爱，但是她很尊重，能为一个人付出生命，玉箫是个很了不起的人。

回到凤辞仙宫，陆章已经走了，林一一和白琅还在。

时笙和白琅说了玉箫的事，白琅提出要去看看玉箫，也带着林一一告辞。

“小殊。”凤辞站在时笙身侧，“从今天起，你就是我的妻子，我将用生命保护的人。”

时笙心跳莫名的漏了半拍，愣怔的看着凤辞，直到唇瓣上传来温热，她瑟缩了下，凤辞动作顿了顿，耐心的等着时笙适应。

好一会儿时笙才开始回应他。

时笙第二天才知道君无期说冥蝶有毒，还给了她一个暧昧的眼神是什么意思。

妈的，那就是春丨药啊！

而且还是有潜伏期的，很长一段时间，时笙和凤辞都沉浸在爱与被爱中。

等药效过去，时笙立即杀到魔界——找君无期报仇。

时笙发现君无期也是个能作死的，本来让她报复一下，这事也就完了，可偏偏他要作死的报复回来。

于是魔界几乎每天都在鸡飞狗跳。

#魔君荣获毁坏建筑宗师勋章#

#魔君又在被追杀#

#一大早起来就看到魔君在挂在自家门前的树上#

#啪啪的时候魔君从天而降，感觉以后再也木有性福生活了#

#仙界群众发来贺电#

#修真界群众发来贺电#

#妖界群众发来贺电#

妖界是什么鬼，这里没有妖界的戏，你乱入什么！

#冥界群众发来贺电#

#魔界群众哭了#

时笙在修真界待了将近万年，这万年的时间，她祸害了不少地方，几乎没人不知道她的名号，她甚至还想挑起几界大战。

关键时刻，几界的掌权人一合计，绝不能上当，五界群众出现了前所未有的团结场面。

大战挑不起来，她就去撩拨那些族群干群架，偏偏她撩完了就不管了。

怎么会有这种人！啊呸，仙！

求天道毁灭！

时笙临死前，将布丁放了，这家伙不怎么喜欢她，很少出来，时笙让它走，它第一次露出了比较和善的表情——然后头也不会的走了。

On the top of Beishan, two red figures stood side by side.

Shi Sheng looked at the tomb with the tombstone. There was a set of clothes scattered beside the tomb, which belonged to Yu Xiao.

After burying Yu Xiao's clothes next to her and setting up the stone tablet, Shi Sheng bowed politely. When she noticed that Feng Ci didn't respond, she glared at Feng Ci.

Feng Ci looked at her innocently.

Why is the good-looking Xiao Shu staring at him?Doesn't he look good today?

Shi Sheng pulled him to bow forcefully.

Shi Sheng stood silently for a while, and then went down the mountain with Feng Ci.

She can't understand those deep loves, but she respects them very much and can give her life to one person. Yuxiao is an amazing person.

Back at Fengci Fairy Palace, Lu Zhang had left, but Lin Yiyi and Bai Lang were still there.

Shi Sheng and Bai Lang talked about Yu Xiao. Bai Lang proposed to go see Yu Xiao and took Lin Yi to leave.

"Xiao Shu." Feng Ci stood beside Shi Sheng, "From today on, you are my wife, the one I will protect with my life."

Shi Sheng's heartbeat inexplicably missed half a beat, and she stared at Feng Ci blankly. She flinched when warmth came to her lips. Feng Ci paused, waiting patiently for Shi Sheng to adapt.

It took a while before Shi Sheng began to respond to him.

Shi Sheng didn't know until the next day what Jun Wuqi meant when he said Mingdie was poisonous and gave her an ambiguous look.

Damn it, that’s an aphrodisiac!

And there is still an incubation period. For a long time, Shi Sheng and Feng Ci were immersed in love and being loved.

When the effects of the medicine wore off, Shi Sheng immediately went to the demon world to seek revenge on Jun.

Shi Sheng discovered that Jun Wuqi was also capable of seeking death. He originally asked her to take revenge and the matter would be over, but he decided to come back seeking revenge.

As a result, the devil world is in a state of chaos almost every day.

#魔君won the Medal of Master of Destroyed Architecture#

#魔君在被hunt了#

#I woke up early in the morning and saw the devil hanging on the tree in front of my house#

#When I have sex, the devil falls from the sky, and I feel that I will never have a happy sex life again#

#仙界人送Messages of Congratulations#

# The people in the world of cultivation sent congratulatory messages#

#魔界人送Messages of Congratulations#

What the hell is the demon world? There is no drama about the demon world here. What are you getting into!

#夜生活的人 Send congratulatory messages#

#魔界人狠#

Shi Sheng has been in the world of cultivation for nearly ten thousand years. During these ten thousand years, she has caused harm to many places. Almost no one knows her name. She even wants to start wars in several worlds.

At the critical moment, the people in power from several circles must not be fooled, and there was an unprecedented scene of unity among the people of the five circles.

When she couldn't start a war, she went to provoke those ethnic groups into fighting, but she just ignored them after the provocation.

How could there be such a person!Ah, bah, fairy!

Pray for destruction from heaven!

Before Shi Sheng died, he released the pudding. This guy didn't like her very much and rarely came out. Shi Sheng let him go. For the first time, he showed a kinder expression - and then he left without turning his head.
